title: Zenodo-22150094: example stereo-EEG (sEEG) recording with one clinically confirmed seizure
description: A single stereo-EEG (sEEG) recording from one patient undergoing clinical intracranial monitoring, containing one clinically confirmed seizure with bilateral tonic-clonic evolution. The EDF+ file has 100 sEEG contacts across 12 electrodes plus 2 marker channels, sampled at 256 Hz for about 3.9 hours. Annotations mark the seizure and its clinical onset. The dataset is a BIDS iEEG conversion of a Zenodo deposit.
methods_description: The released EDF+ file was copied byte-identically into iEEG-BIDS, with channels, events and electrodes sidecars derived from the file header and annotations. No signal processing was applied. The recording has 102 signals (100 sEEG contacts, 2 marker inputs) at 256 Hz, with a 16-bit range of +-3200 uV.
